patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Airtable and Motion share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Airtable only if your buying job matches “Flexible database / app platform with interfaces and light project apps — Team from ~$20/u” rather than Motion's shape. Choose Motion only if your buying job matches “AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI from $19/seat/mo an” rather than Airtable's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Airtable is shaped for Flexible database / app platform with interfaces and light project app whereas Motion is shaped for AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Airtable and Motion share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Airtable is Flexible database / app platform with interfaces and light project apps — Team from ~$20/user/mo annual.; Motion is AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI from $19/seat/mo annual..
- Company-size focus: Airtable (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Motion (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Researched limits: Airtable — Higher seat floors than Notion/ClickUp; Motion — Premium $19+ seats vs broader Work OS floors.

Limitations — Airtable: Higher seat floors than Notion/ClickUp; Builder complexity; Motion: Premium $19+ seats vs broader Work OS floors; AI credit caps and top-ups affect TCO.

Poor-fit cases: Airtable is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Higher seat floors than Notion/ClickUp · Motion is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Premium $19+ seats vs broader Work OS floors · Avoid Airtable if you actually need Motion's motion (AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI from $19/)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
